description: Implementation of CalendarReadPlatformService for accessing calendar data from the database, including retrieval, generation of recurring dates, and handling calendar history within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CalendarReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing calendar data retrieval and processing logic, including recurring date generation and history handling.

classes.name: CalendarDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to CalendarData objects.

classes.name: CalendarDataFromHistoryMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set from calendar history to CalendarData objects.

methods.name: retrieveCalendar
methods.description: Fetches a specific calendar by ID, entity ID, and entity type.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves calendars associated with a specific entity, optionally filtered by calendar types.

methods.name: retrieveCollctionCalendarByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the collection calendar for a specific entity.

methods.name: retrieveParentCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves parent calendars based on entity hierarchy and types.

methods.name: retrieveAllCalendars
methods.description: Fetches all calendars from the database.

methods.name: retrieveNewCalendarDetails
methods.description: Provides default details for creating a new calendar.

methods.name: generateRecurringDates
methods.description: Generates recurring dates for a calendar, optionally including history.

methods.name: generateNextTenRecurringDates
methods.description: Generates the next ten recurring dates for a calendar.

methods.name: isCalendarAssociatedWithEntity
methods.description: Checks if a calendar is associated with a specific entity.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves the calendar associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: getParentHierarchyCondition
methods.description: Returns SQL condition string for parent hierarchy based on entity type.

methods.name: retrieveApplicableCalendarFromHistory
methods.description: Fetches applicable calendar data from history based on calendar ID and date.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsFromHistory
methods.description: Retrieves calendar history entries for a given calendar ID.

methods.name: generateRecurringDate
methods.description: Internal method to generate recurring dates based on recurrence rules and date ranges.

methods.name: getSeedDate
methods.description: Returns the seed date for recurrence calculations.

methods.name: getPeriodStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the start date for recurrence period based on various parameters.

methods.name: getPeriodEndDate
methods.description: Calculates the end date for recurrence period based on various parameters.

methods.name: generateNextEligibleMeetingDateForCollection
methods.description: Calculates the next eligible meeting date for collection based on calendar and last meeting data.

methods.name: updateWithRecurringDates
methods.description: Updates a collection of calendars with generated recurring dates.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalendar
methods.description: Fetches the calendar associated with a loan.
